scope: The exact declaration and binding source used to produce a resolved SQLite column removal.

src/Ir/Schema/Alter/AlterTargetLowering..role: Absolute schema and table lookup from the native relation binding.

src/Model/Facade/Catalog.php.role: Attach the removal projection to the concrete declaration in every standard SQL-catalog input route.

src/Model/Statement/Declaration/ColumnRe.role: Detached immutable map of protected ordinals in one declared heading.

src/Model/Statement/Declaration/Table.ph.role: The declaration can supply a projection only when the relation is an ordinary table and the complete heading matches the projected width.

src/Rules/Definition/DropRestrictions.ph.role: Collect protected keys and surviving expressions from the native resolved column facts, retaining the rowid and folded-operand distinction.

src/Rules/Definition/Expression/Limits.p.role: Reject live schema constructs while dropping the empty-membership operand before semantic limits, including in both index roles. Preserve inert lexical registrations.

src/Rules/Definition/AlterationProblems..role: Reject an unknown or sole column during binding before the complete removal is built.

src/Statement/Schema/AlterDropColumn.php.role: Derive the concrete relation occurrence and native removal diagnostics.

src/Lowering/Definition/SchemaRule.php.role: Bind the fixed grammar's ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN statement and its identifier roles.
